title: Reduce hero banner height by half and show only one quote (UZ)

requirements.text: Reduce the hero banner image height on the Gallery page (frontend/src/pages/Gallery.tsx) to exactly half its current value. Adjust any related CSS classes or inline styles accordingly so the banner proportions and layout remain visually clean.

quotes: Das Bannerbild bitte um die hälfte in der Höhe reduzieren

acceptanceCriteria: The hero banner section height is 50% of its previous height.
The banner image still fills the reduced height correctly (no white space or overflow).
Layout below the banner is not broken.

requirements.text: Update the rotating quotes section inside the hero banner on the Gallery page (frontend/src/pages/Gallery.tsx) to display only the UZ quote (from Russell, 'Geheimnis des Lichtes'). Remove the Goethe quote and any rotation/carousel logic so that a single static quote is shown.
acceptanceCriteria: Only one quote is displayed in the banner — the Russell 'Geheimnis des Lichtes' (UZ) quote.
The Goethe quote is no longer shown.
No rotation animation or carousel indicator is present.
The quote text is legible against the banner background.

constraints: Do not modify any files listed under frontend.immutablePaths.
nonGoals: Changing any other section of the Gallery page beyond the hero banner.
Modifying quote content/text beyond removing the Goethe entry.
